Build a RISC-V CPU from Zero
============================

How to start
------------
Open index.html in Chrome, Edge, or Firefox (double-click it, or drag it
into a browser window). Nothing needs to be installed and no internet
connection is needed.

The simulator's unit tests can be run from tests.html (or the "Tests"
link in the top bar).

Troubleshooting
---------------
- The page says "Loading the course..." and never changes:
  JavaScript is turned off. Turn it on for local files, or try another
  browser.
- The page is blank or lessons do not load:
  keep the folder structure intact. index.html needs the "assets" folder
  next to it. Do not move index.html out of this folder on its own.
  If the folder is inside a .zip file, extract it first.
- Progress is not saved between visits:
  the browser is blocking local storage for files opened from disk
  (some privacy settings do this, and private windows forget it on
  close). The course still works; progress just resets.
  In Firefox, check that "Delete cookies and site data when Firefox is
  closed" is off, or add an exception.
- Text or the diagram looks very small:
  zoom the page with Ctrl and + (Cmd and + on a Mac). Each diagram also
  has a "100%" button that shows it full size inside a scrolling box.
- Safari and very old browsers are not supported. Use a current Chrome,
  Edge or Firefox.
